// Root-only fixed forward452 migration; no resolve/reset/seed or direct ledger DML.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync,readdirSync,existsSync} from 'node:fs';
import {createRequire} from 'node:module';
import {execFileSync,spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {checkServerIdentity} from 'node:tls';
// BEGIN FIXED RDS TLS OPTIONS (exercised verbatim by owned-loopback tests).
const RDS_CA_SHA256='b1711d12bae51838581281e23b6cb97b1074016873b4dafc80ed14002462dd77';
const RDS_CA_PEM=Buffer.from('','base64').toString('utf8');
function rdsTlsOptions(connectionString){
  assert.equal(createHash('sha256').update(RDS_CA_PEM).digest('hex'),RDS_CA_SHA256);
  const databaseUrl=new URL(connectionString);
  assert.equal(databaseUrl.protocol,'postgresql:');
  assert.match(databaseUrl.hostname,/^[a-z0-9.-]+\.us-east-1\.rds\.amazonaws\.com$/u);
  assert.equal(databaseUrl.searchParams.get('sslmode'),'require');
  assert.equal(databaseUrl.searchParams.getAll('sslmode').length,1);
  for(const name of databaseUrl.searchParams.keys())assert.ok(['schema','sslmode','connection_limit'].includes(name));
  // pg-connection-string sslmode would replace the explicit ssl object.
  databaseUrl.searchParams.delete('sslmode');
  return {connectionString:databaseUrl.toString(),ssl:{ca:RDS_CA_PEM,rejectUnauthorized:true,
    servername:databaseUrl.hostname,
    checkServerIdentity:(_hostname,certificate)=>checkServerIdentity(databaseUrl.hostname,certificate)}};
}
// END FIXED RDS TLS OPTIONS
const SOURCE='be4d886ffa774f72e0ed5c5268995109cbd11220';
const NEW='20261005160000_krisp_notetaker';
const XLSX='20281007020000_clio_attachments_xlsx_kind';
const mode=process.env.KRISP_DB_MODE;
const hash=v=>createHash('sha256').update(typeof v==='string'?v:JSON.stringify(v)).digest('hex');
const require=createRequire('/app/apps/api/package.json');
const {Client}=require('pg');
let client,stage='connect';
const emit=value=>console.log('KRISP_DB_RECEIPT '+JSON.stringify(value));
const ledgerSql='SELECT id,migration_name,checksum,started_at::text,finished_at::text,rolled_back_at::text,applied_steps_count FROM _prisma_migrations ORDER BY migration_name,id';
const flagsSql="SELECT slug::text,settings_jsonb->'clioFeatureFlags'->>'notetaker.krisp.enabled' AS enabled FROM tenants WHERE slug IN ('capiro-internal','c2-strategies') ORDER BY slug";
async function state(){
 await client.query('BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY');
 try{
  await client.query("SET LOCAL app.bypass_rls='on'");
  const ledger=(await client.query(ledgerSql)).rows;
  assert.equal(ledger.filter(x=>!x.finished_at&&!x.rolled_back_at).length,0);
  const flags=(await client.query(flagsSql)).rows;assert.equal(flags.length,2);
  const other=(await client.query("SELECT id,settings_jsonb FROM tenants WHERE slug NOT IN ('capiro-internal','c2-strategies') ORDER BY id")).rows;
  const tables=(await client.query("SELECT relname,relrowsecurity,relforcerowsecurity,has_table_privilege('capiro_app',oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') AS grants FROM pg_class WHERE relname IN ('krisp_notetaker_preferences','krisp_meeting_imports') ORDER BY relname")).rows;
  const role=(await client.query('SELECT rolsuper,rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user')).rows[0];
  return {ledger,flags,otherHash:hash(other),tables,role};
 }finally{await client.query('ROLLBACK');}
}
try{
 assert.ok(['inspect','apply'].includes(mode));
 const connectionString=execFileSync(process.execPath,['/app/apps/api/scripts/lib/pe-compose-database-url.js'],{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']});
 client=new Client({...rdsTlsOptions(connectionString),connectionTimeoutMillis:15000,query_timeout:15000});await client.connect();
 assert.equal(client.connection.stream.authorized,true);
 const before=await state();
 const root='/app/apps/api/prisma/migrations';
 const manifest=readdirSync(root).filter(n=>existsSync(root+'/'+n+'/migration.sql')).sort().map(name=>({name,sha256:hash(readFileSync(root+'/'+name+'/migration.sql','utf8'))}));
 const pending=manifest.filter(x=>!before.ledger.some(y=>y.migration_name===x.name&&y.finished_at&&!y.rolled_back_at));
 emit({mode,stage:'preflight',ledgerHash:hash(before.ledger),ledgerRows:before.ledger.length,pending,flags:before.flags,tables:before.tables,role:before.role,manifestSha256:hash(manifest),tlsVerified:true});
 if(mode==='apply'){
  stage='guard';assert.equal(process.env.GIT_SHA,SOURCE);assert.equal(manifest.length,454);assert.equal(hash(before.ledger),process.env.KRISP_EXPECTED_LEDGER);
  assert.ok(pending.some(x=>x.name===NEW));assert.ok(pending.every(x=>[NEW,XLSX].includes(x.name)));assert.equal(before.tables.length,0);

  await client.end();client=undefined;
  const cert='/dev/shm/krisp-rds-ca.pem';writeFileSync(cert,RDS_CA_PEM,{flag:'wx',mode:0o600});
  const url=new URL(connectionString);url.searchParams.set('sslmode','require');url.searchParams.set('sslaccept','strict');url.searchParams.set('sslcert',cert);url.searchParams.set('options','-c app.bypass_rls=on -c lock_timeout=5000 -c statement_timeout=120000');
  const probe=new (require('@prisma/client').PrismaClient)({datasources:{db:{url:url.toString()}}});try{assert.equal((await probe.$queryRawUnsafe("SELECT current_setting('app.bypass_rls') AS bypass"))[0].bypass,'on');}finally{await probe.$disconnect();}
  const env={...process.env,DATABASE_URL:url.toString(),PRISMA_HIDE_UPDATE_MESSAGE:'1'};delete env.DIRECT_URL;
  stage='migrate';emit({stage,status:'intent',pending});
  const run=spawnSync(process.execPath,[require.resolve('prisma'),'migrate','deploy','--schema','/app/apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma'],{cwd:'/app/apps/api',env,encoding:'utf8',timeout:180000,maxBuffer:4*1024*1024});
  const output=String(run.stdout??'')+String(run.stderr??'');emit({stage,exitCode:run.status,outputSha256:hash(output),errorCode:output.match(/\bP[0-9]{4}\b/)?.[0]??null});assert.equal(run.status,0);
  stage='postcheck';client=new Client({...rdsTlsOptions(connectionString),connectionTimeoutMillis:15000,query_timeout:15000});await client.connect();const after=await state();
  assert.deepEqual(after.ledger.filter(x=>!pending.some(y=>y.name===x.migration_name)),before.ledger);
  for(const x of pending){const rows=after.ledger.filter(y=>y.migration_name===x.name);assert.equal(rows.length,1);assert.equal(rows[0].checksum,x.sha256);assert.ok(rows[0].finished_at);assert.equal(rows[0].rolled_back_at,null);}
  assert.equal(after.otherHash,before.otherHash);assert.ok(after.flags.every(x=>x.enabled==='true'));assert.equal(after.tables.length,2);assert.ok(after.tables.every(x=>x.relrowsecurity&&x.relforcerowsecurity&&x.grants));
  emit({stage:'complete',status:'passed',sourceSha:SOURCE,ledgerHash:hash(after.ledger),priorLedgerUnchanged:true,otherTenantsUnchanged:true,flags:after.flags,tables:after.tables,pendingApplied:pending});
 }
}catch(e){emit({stage,status:'failed',code:e.code??'ERROR',assertion:e.code==='ERR_ASSERTION'?e.message:undefined});process.exitCode=1;}
finally{await client?.end().catch(()=>{});}
